defiscan.summary: Uniswap V3 is an automated market maker built around concentrated liquidity, where LP positions are issued as NFTs by the NonfungiblePositionManager and traded against pools deployed by the UniswapV3Factory. Governance runs through Compound Governor Bravo: UNI holders propose and vote on-chain (2.5M UNI to propose, 40M UNI quorum, ~7-day voting window), and successful proposals execute after a 48-hour Timelock delay. The minter role on the UNI token is held by the Timelock, with minting limited to 2% of supply per year and a 365-day minimum interval between mints — both limits are hardcoded in the token contract.

details.name: Uniswap Governance (GovernorBravo)
details.description: governance · Immutable — The on-chain governance proxy (GovernorBravoDelegator) that UNI holders use to propose and vote on protocol changes. Proposals require 2.5M UNI to submit and 40M UNI quorum to pass; the voting window is approximately 7 days. Approved proposals are forwarded to the Timelock for a mandatory 48-hour delay. details.name: V3OpenFeeAdapter
details.description: Immutable — Intermediate owner of UniswapV3Factory. Can enable new fee tiers (enableFeeAmount), set per-tier and per-pool protocol fee overrides (setDefaultFee, setPoolOverride), and transfer factory ownership (setOwner, setFactoryOwner). The protocol fee take is hard-capped: each per-direction fee divisor must be 0 or in [4, 10], bounding the protocol's share to at most 25% of LP swap fees. V3OpenFeeAdapter…

details.name: Firepit
details.description: Immutable — Accumulates UNI tokens from the TokenJar and periodically burns them by sending to the dead address (0x...dEaD) once a configurable threshold is reached. Firepit is Timelock-owned; governance controls the threshold amount (setThreshold) and the thresholdSetter role. It holds no LP or user funds.

findings.title: Immutable code
findings.description: Every protocol contract is deployed as immutable bytecode. Admins can still write to on-chain parameters exposed by these contracts, but they cannot change the code itself.

findings.title: $949.7M TVS

findings.title: Fully autonomous protocol
findings.description: The protocol does not depend on any external contracts, operating entirely through its own on-chain logic.

details.name: Weights
details.description: pigi’s fixed formula: score = 0.6 × node rating + 0.4 × vault score. With no rated vault the node rating stands alone.

pigi.note: Headline: uniswap-v3. Vault score counts Ethereum vaults only.

text: score = 0.6 × the protocol node's own rating + 0.4 × the TVL-weighted mean (weight = tvl_30d_ma share) of the latest published score of every rated vault that deposits into it; with no rated vault the node rating stands alone (applied.k1 = 1). The band is read straight off the thresholds, without the dwell rule that smooths vault bands, so it can move on any day. A vault that deposits into more than one protocol node (every Morpho vault: the framework and the Blue instance) counts toward each. Vault scores are the published ones — their caps were computed against the node rating as of their own date, so after a node re-rate the two terms agree again at the next nightly. chain_id narrows the vault set only.
